_how: Newest first is automatic (by date). Each story: slug, date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, dek (one-line summary), kicker, body (list of paragraphs; a paragraph can be {"photo": n} to place photo n there), photos [{src, alt, caption}], optional youtube (video id), optional places/sights/events (slugs to link).

author.name: HCMC Insider
author.about: A local in Ho Chi Minh City who eats, walks and photographs the city, mostly around Cholon.
